accepted.simpleMeaning: a state in which the two sides of an account, money received and money paid, are equal
accepted.scope: This is not the pleasing arrangement of a design and not physical steadiness; it concerns the two sides of a financial account.
examples: After the audit, the account was in balance.
The books were out of balance until the missing invoice was found.
branchCoverage: equality between the totals of the credit and debit sides of an account -> a state in which the two sides of an account, money received and money paid, are equal

accepted.definition: compute credits and debits of an account
accepted.simpleMeaning: to add up the money received and the money paid in an account
accepted.scope: This is not the act of making things equal in weight and not the state of an account; it is the work of adding up its entries.
examples: She balances the accounts every Friday afternoon.
He spent the evening balancing the company's books.
branchCoverage: compute credits and debits of an account -> to add up the money received and the money paid in an account
sourceBranches: compute credits and debits of an account

accepted.definition: bring into balance or equilibrium
accepted.simpleMeaning: to make two or more things equal or steady so that no side is heavier or stronger
accepted.scope: This is not about adding up an account and not about the parts of a design; it is making things equal or steady.
examples: She balanced the tray on one hand.
You need to balance work and rest.
branchCoverage: bring into balance or equilibrium -> to make two or more things equal or steady so that no side is heavier or stronger
sourceBranches: bring into balance or equilibrium

accepted.definition: a game played with playing cards
accepted.simpleMeaning: a game in which players use a set of small printed pieces with numbers and pictures
accepted.scope: This is not the printed pieces themselves, but the game played with them.
examples: The children were playing cards on the floor.
He learned to play cards from his grandfather.
branchCoverage: a game played with playing cards -> a game in which players use a set of small printed pieces with numbers and pictures
sourceBranches: a game played with playing cards

accepted.definition: marked by continuous change or effective action
accepted.simpleMeaning: never staying the same, but always moving, developing, or producing effects
accepted.scope: This is not about a single change that has already happened, but about something that keeps moving or developing.
examples: We live in a changing world.
The city has a changing population, with new groups arriving every year.
branchCoverage: marked by continuous change or effective action -> never staying the same, but always moving, developing, or producing effects
sourceBranches: marked by continuous change or effective action

accepted.definition: a relation between things or events (as in the case of one causing the other or sharing features with it)
accepted.simpleMeaning: a link between two things or events, such as one causing the other or sharing features with it
accepted.scope: This is not a wire or joint and not the state of being joined; it is an abstract link between things or events.
examples: There is a clear connection between smoking and lung disease.
Police found no connection between the two crimes.
branchCoverage: a relation between things or events (as in the case of one causing the other or sharing features with it) -> a link between two things or events, such as one causing the other or sharing features with it

accepted.definition: an instrumentality that connects
accepted.simpleMeaning: a piece of equipment, such as a wire or pipe, that joins two things together
accepted.scope: This is not an abstract link between ideas or events and not the state of being joined; it is the physical piece that joins things.
examples: The plumber replaced the rusty connection under the sink.
The electrician tightened every connection in the fuse box.
branchCoverage: an instrumentality that connects -> a piece of equipment, such as a wire or pipe, that joins two things together

accepted.definition: the state of being connected
accepted.simpleMeaning: the condition of being joined or linked to something
accepted.scope: This is not the wire or plug itself and not a link of cause or shared features between things or events; it is the condition of being joined to a system or line.
examples: My phone keeps losing its connection to the network.
The video call failed because the connection was poor.
branchCoverage: the state of being connected -> the condition of being joined or linked to something
sourceBranches: the state of being connected
